During either routine health check or some of the most frightening health moments I have faced recentl where at risk of losing my hearing, this team has met me with genuine care, calm professionalism, and a level of compassion that is increasingly rare.

When you are scared and vulnerable, those things matter deeply and every person here has made a difference.

From Lorraine W at reception, who handled everything with such kindness, patience, and professionalism when I felt overwhelmed, to the doctors who took the time to truly listen, understand my concerns, and guide me toward the right solutions, the standard of care has been remarkable throughout.

Having recently experienced BUPA as well, the contrast is striking. I will be dropping BUPA *because* of this team and my experience with BUPA  has only reinforced how extraordinary the team at Paddington Green Health Centre really is. The care here is not only efficient and professional, it is deeply human.

I am profoundly grateful for this health centre and for the people who work within it. They do not just provide medical support; they restore reassurance, dignity, and trust when people need it most.

In my view, one of the very best health centres in London. Thank you Paddington Green.
